sourceEnglishObjective: Keep workers below clear of debris
sourceEnglishSpeaking: Tell the ground crew to move clear before tear-off resumes.
candidateObjective: 地上班が落下する廃材に近づかないよう伝える。
candidateFocus: ～の下に identifies a prohibited location. ～まで marks how long the crew waits, and ～前に orders warning before using the chute.

archivedForms.exampleJa: 立入禁止区域の周りに警告テープを張ります。
archivedForms.exampleEnglish: We put up the warning tape around the exclusion area.

archivedForms.exampleJa: 撤去作業の前に全員が家から離れます。
archivedForms.exampleEnglish: Everyone moves away from the house before the tear-off.

archivedForms.exampleJa: 職長が安全を確認したと言うまで待ちます。
archivedForms.exampleEnglish: We wait until the foreman says it's clear.

archivedForms.exampleJa: 廃材用シュートを使うなら先に周囲の人に知らせます。
archivedForms.exampleEnglish: If we use the debris chute, we warn people first.

archivedForms.exampleJa: 頭上注意！廃材が落ちます！

archivedSpeaking.opening: 地上班は家から離れてください。警告テープを張り、私が安全を確認したと言うまで待ってください。
archivedSpeaking.goal: Tell the ground crew to move clear before tear-off resumes.

curriculumAdaptationNote: Preserve the source scene in order: before tear-off resumes, the foreman addresses the ground crew; falling debris can injure people below; warning tape marks the exclusion area; workers move away and do not stand below even with hard hats; if a debris chute is used, warn people first with an immediate heads-up; then wait for the source speaker's all-clear. Archived Japanese narrows tear-off, adds cone color and safety-verification claims, and softens the immediate warning. Product/site boundary and release authority need qualified review. Current curriculum has no authored verb-example list; archived forms remain conditional evidence. No selected learner/audio text or progress identity is created.

cards.reviewNote: Exclusion area is an established boundary around falling-debris work. Archived 立入禁止区域 implies a full entry ban; confirm the site-zone sense and marking before selecting a scored term.
Warning tape is an unspecified site control in the source. Confirm 警告テープ and the site-specific warning/marking sense, without inventing a particular tape specification.
Chute means debris chute in this source. Confirm 廃材用シュート against the actual debris-control equipment and usage before a site instruction.
Source cone is generic; archived カラーコーン specifies a colored cone. Remove the added attribute or confirm source intent.
Tear-off / desmontaje may cover more than 既存屋根材の撤去. Confirm the removal scope against source objective and site work sequence.
